what: max2 SFX-2c: decoded onset-to-peak (ms, -40 dB onset to sample peak) and HF energy shares of every kit hit and per-ability impact (audio/out, numpy), and the reason per cue for each one still over 3 ms or under the HF floors (2-6 kHz >= 4 %, >6 kHz >= 0.6 %)

f_ardit_hit.why: SNAP_TUNE None: every snap state (default, 0.3/2 ms, 0.3/1 ms, 0.1/1 ms) put this cue or a neighbour in the ability-impact slot under the 8 dB identity bar + 0.15 dB codec margin (audio/snap_search.py); the cue keeps its own onset. f_dunsom_attack_hit.why: by design: the recipe is 'the mote lands: a soft hollow clonk (a nudge, not a blade)', voiced with a 1.2 kHz low-pass (kits_c VOICING); CRACK_TUNE scale 0 (round 1 crack_search: any crack moved it toward Hesmi's attack hit, the nearest at 9.2 dB confusability). A bright layer would contradict the fighter's gentle identity.

f_dunsom_hit.why: crack held at 0.3 (CRACK_TUNE): its nearest ability impact is Marund's at 8.2 dB confusability (bar 8.0); more crack takes it under. Since SFX-4 Dunsom's ult and a2 have their own impacts (f_dunsom_ult_hit, f_dunsom_a2_hit).

f_hesmi_attack_hit.why: by design ('a dull, dead punch, no ring, nothing bright'): 2-6 kHz 4.9 % clears that floor; >6 kHz is held back for the same Ulkro pair (8.4 dB).

f_lisvel_attack_hit.why: 2-6 kHz 10 % clears that floor; the >6 kHz air (0.14 %) is held at scale 0 because Lisvel's and Burdam's autos sit 8.5 dB apart by the spectral measure; its signature is the 330 Hz shaft quiver (the recipe), which a laptop plays.

f_nurrow_hit.why: 6-12 kHz 3.6 % clears that floor; 2-6 kHz (2.2 %) is held under it because that band carries Ardit's impact (8.4 dB confusability); its ult and heaviest ability now have their own impacts.

f_tunlan_hit.why: CRACK_TUNE scale 0: its nearest impact is Dunsom's (8.9 dB confusability) and the crack search found every crack level closes that pair; its ult and a1 now carry their own impacts.

f_ulkro_attack_hit.why: by design ('a hard wooden thock and the shaft left quivering'): 2-6 kHz 5.8 % clears that floor; >6 kHz air is the band that pairs it with Hesmi's auto (8.4 dB confusability, 0.4 dB over the bar), so it stays at scale 0.

f_ulkro_hit.why: 6-12 kHz 0.9 % clears that floor; its crack is at 0.8 (CRACK_TUNE) and 2-6 kHz (3.0 %) sits just under 4 %: Ardit's and Burdam's impacts are its neighbours at 8.3-8.4 dB by both measures, the slot's tightest pair. Its ult and heaviest ability have their own impacts since SFX-4.
